thag20.1:1.1: Paññāsanipāto samatto. SAṬṬHIKANIPĀTO. Āraññakā piṇḍapātikā uñchāpattāgate ratā dālemu Maccuno senaṃ ajjhattaṃ susamāhitā. || ||
thag20.1:2.1: āraññakā piṇḍapātikā uñchāpattāgate ratā dhunāma Maccuno senaṃ naḷāgāraṃ va kuñjaro. || ||
thag20.1:3.1: rukkhamūlikā sātatikā uñchāpattāgate ratā dālemu . . . susamāhitā. || ||
thag20.1:4.1: rukkhamūlikā sāt. uñch. r. dhunāma . . . kuñjaro. || ||
thag20.1:5.1: aṭṭhikaṅkalakuṭike maṃsanhāruppasibbite dhir atthu pūre duggandhe paragatte mamāyase || ||
thag20.1:6.1: gūthabhaste taconaddhe uragaṇḍapisācini nava sotāni te kāye yāni sandanti sabbadā. || ||
thag20.1:7.1: tava sarīraṃ navasotaṃ duggandhaṃ kariparibandha, bhikkhu parivajjayate taṃ mīḷhaṃ va yathā sucikāmo. || ||
thag20.1:8.1: evañ ce taṃ jano jaññā yathā jānāmi taṃ ahaṃ, ārakā parivajjeyya gūthaṭṭhānaṃ va pāvuse. || ||
thag20.1:9.1: evam etaṃ mahāvīra yathā samaṇa bhāsasi, ettha c' eke visīdanti paṅkamhi va jaraggavo. || ||
thag20.1:10.1: ākāsamhi haliddāya yo maññetha rajetave aññena vāpi raṅgena, vighātudayam eva taṃ. || ||
thag20.1:11.1: tadākāsasamaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ; mā pāpacitte āhari aggikkhandhaṃ va pakkhimā.
thag20.1:19.1: tadāsi yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadāsi lomahaṃsanaṃ anekākārasampanne Sāriputtamhi nibbute. || ||
thag20.1:21.1: sukhumaṃ paṭivijjhanti vālaggam usunā yathā ye pañca khandhe passanti parato no ca attato. || ||
thag20.1:22.1: ye ca passanti saṃkhāre parato no ca attato, paccabyādhiṃsu nipuṇaṃ vālaggaṃ usunā yathā.
thag20.1:25.1: codito bhāvitattena sarīrantimadhārinā Migāramātu pāsādaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhena kampayiṃ. || ||
thag20.1:26.1: na yidaṃ sithilam ārabbha na yidaṃ appena thāmasā nibbānam adhigantabbaṃ sabbaganthapamocanaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:27.1: ayañ ca daharo bhikkhu, ayam uttamaporiso dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā Māraṃ savāhanaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:28.1: vivaram anupatanti vijjutā Vebhārassa ca Paṇḍavassa ca, nagavivaragato ca jhāyati putto appaṭimassa tādino. || ||
thag20.1:29.1: upasanto uparato pantasenāsano muni dāyādo buddhaseṭṭhassa Brahmunā abhivandito. || ||
thag20.1:30.1: upasantaṃ uparataṃ pantasenāsanaṃ muniṃ dāyādaṃ buddhaseṭṭhassa vanda brāhmaṇa Kassapaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:31.1: yo ca jātisataṃ gacche sabbā brāhmaṇajātiyo sotthiyo vedasampanno manussesu punappunaṃ, || ||
thag20.1:32.1: ajjhāyako pi ce assa tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū, etassa vandanāy' ekaṃ kalaṃ n' agghati soḷasiṃ. || ||
thag20.1:33.1: yo so aṭṭha vimokkhāni purebhattaṃ apassayi anulomaṃ paṭilomaṃ, tato piṇḍāya gacchati: || ||
thag20.1:34.1: tādisaṃ bhikkhuṃ māhari, māttānaṃ khaṇi brāhmaṇa, abhippasādehi manaṃ arahantamhi tādine, khippaṃ pañjaliko vanda mā te vijaṭi matthakaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:35.1: na so passati saddhammaṃ saṃsārena purakkhato, acaṅkamaṃ jimhapathaṃ kumaggam anudhāvati. || ||
thag20.1:36.1: kimī va mīḷhasallitto saṃkhāre adhimucchito pagāḷho lābhasakkāre tuccho gacchati Poṭṭhilo. || ||
thag20.1:37.1: imañ ca passa āyantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ sudassanaṃ vimuttaṃ ubhatobhāge ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ.' || ||
thag20.1:38.1: visallaṃ khīṇasaṃyogaṃ tevijjaṃ maccuhāyinaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ manussānaṃ puññakhettam anuttaraṃ. || ||
thag20.1:39.1: ete sambahulā devā iddhimanto yasassino dasa devasahassāni sabbe brahmapurohitā Moggallānaṃ namassantā tiṭṭhantī pañjalīkatā: || ||
thag20.1:40.1: namo te purisājañña, namo te purisuttama, yassa te āsavā khīṇā, dakkhiṇeyyo 'si mārisa. || ||
thag20.1:41.1: pūjito naradevena uppanno maraṇābhibhū puṇḍarīkaṃ va toyena saṃkhāre nopalippati. || ||
thag20.1:42.1: yasse muhutte sahassadhā loko saṃvidito, sa Brahmakappo vasī iddhiguṇe cutūpapāte kāle passati devatā sa bhikkhu. || ||
thag20.1:43.1: Sāriputto va paññāya sīlena upasamena ca, yo pi pāraṃgato bhikkhu etāvaparamo siyā. || ||
thag20.1:44.1: koṭisatasahassassa attabhāvaṃ khaṇena nimmine, ahaṃ vikubbanāsu kusalo vasībhūto 'mhi iddhiyā. || ||
thag20.1:45.1: samādhivijjāvasi pāramīgato Moggallānagotto asitassa sāsane dhīro samucchindi samāhitindriyo nāgo yathā pūtilataṃ va bandhanaṃ.
thag20.1:48.1: kīdiso nirayo āsi yattha Dussī apaccatha Vidhuraṃ sāvakam āsajja Kakusandhañ ca brāhmaṇaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:49.1: satam āsi ayosaṅkū sabbe paccattavedanā: īdiso nirayo āsi yattha Dussī apaccatha Vidhuraṃ sāvakam āsajja Kakusandhañ ca brāhmaṇaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:50.1: yo etam abhijānāti bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, tādisaṃ bhikkhum āsajja Kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
thag20.1:51.1: majjhe sāgarasmiṃ tiṭṭhanti vimānā kappaṭṭhāyino veḷuriyavaṇṇā rucirā accimanto pabhassarā, accharā tattha naccanti puthū nānattavaṇṇiyo, || ||
thag20.1:52.1: yo etam abhi- --pa-- Kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
thag20.1:53.1: yo ve buddhena codito bhikkhusaṃghassa pekkhato Migāramātu pāsādaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhena kampayi, || ||
thag20.1:55.1: yo Vejayantapāsādaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhena kampayi iddhibalen' upatthaddho saṃvejesi ca devatā, || ||
thag20.1:57.1: yo Vejayantapāsāde Sakkaṃ so paripucchati: api āvuso jānāsi taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo;-- tassa Sakko viyākāsi pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ, || ||
thag20.1:59.1: yo Brahmānaṃ paripucchati Sudhammāyaṃ abhitosabhaṃ: ajjāpi te āvuso sā diṭṭhi yā te diṭṭhi pure ahū; passasi vītivattantaṃ Brahmaloke pabhassaraṃ;--|| ||
thag20.1:60.1: tassa Brahmā viyākāsi pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ: na me mārisa sā diṭṭhi yā me diṭṭhi pure ahū; || ||
thag20.1:61.1: passāmi vītivattantaṃ Brahmaloke pabhassaraṃ; so 'ham ajja kathaṃ vajjaṃ: ahaṃ nicco 'mhi sassato;-- || ||
thag20.1:63.1: yo Mahāneruno kūṭaṃ vimokkhena apassayi, vanaṃ Pubbavidehānaṃ ye ca bhūmisayā narā,
thag20.1:65.1: na ve aggi cetayati ahaṃ bālaṃ dahāmīti, bālo ca jalitam aggiṃ āsajja naṃ paḍayhati; || ||
thag20.1:66.1: evam eva tuvaṃ Māra āsajja naṃ tathāgataṃ sayaṃ dahissam attānaṃ bālo aggiṃ va samphusaṃ. || ||
thag20.1:67.1: apuññaṃ pasavī Māro āsajja naṃ tathāgataṃ; kiṃ nu maññasi pāpima na me pāpaṃ vipaccati. || ||
thag20.1:68.1: karato te miyyate pāpaṃ cirarattāya Antaka; Māra nibbinda buddhamhā, āsaṃ mā kāsi bhikkhusu. || ||
thag20.1:69.1: iti Māraṃ atajjesi bhikkhu Bhesakaḷāvane, tato so dummano yakkho tatth' ev' antaradhāyatīti. || || itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno thero gāthāyo abhāsitthā 'ti. uddānaṃ bhavati:
thag20.1:70.0: Saṭṭhikamhi nipātamhi Moggallāno mahiddhiko eko 'va thero, gāthāyo aṭṭhasaṭṭhi bhavanti tā 'ti.
